minor.issue: No HTTP Range support (Range request returns 200 full body, header 'Accept-Ranges: none') and whole MP4 read into memory. iOS/macOS Safari requires 206 byte-range responses for <video> playback/seek, so the archive player em-video-player-* will likely not play on iPhone/Safari (Chrome works). Use FileResponse/StreamingResponse with Range handling.

No Event Map rights/active check (any org admin can upload tracks and render previews without the add-on) and preview subprocess bypasses the render semaphore, so concurrent previews compete for CPU with queued renders.
asyncio.create_task(_process(vid)) result not referenced (task can be GC'd per asyncio docs); keep a set of background tasks. Per-org asyncio.Lock only protects a single worker process.
Same GPX uploaded twice creates duplicate tracks with identical labels in the select ('pisa_run.gpx · 3,8 km · 267 punti' x2); no delete-track endpoint/UI.

ui_bugs.issue: /event-map/{invalid-or-foreign-eid} stays on 'Caricamento...' forever (load() error only toasts, st stays null). Show not-found state / redirect to /event-map.
Filename includes the extension of the track name: 'event-map-pisa_run-gpx-1x1-15s.mp4' (strip .gpx from track_name).

issues: Banner shows in English (EN toggle selected) on an Italian UI for a headless browser locale; consider defaulting to IT.
